informational: plants2 survived because jobrun slots confine a job to CPUs of one node (keke 16-19), making the pin a no-op; any plant of NUMA-placement code must widen the mask
WARN-NOT-RAM on keke: no /mnt/zram there and /dev/shm gives WARN-DEV-SHM, so one warning is unavoidable

impact.what: plants on the one-node pin of the heap address-space test caught (were 0 of 2)
the test prints the CPUs per node it may run on, so a node-related failure shows its placement

improvement: the plants tool could warn when the job's inherited affinity sits on one NUMA node, since that hides any NUMA-placement mutant
